_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Each model carries its own 'checked' date so one stale entry can't hide behind a fresh one. OpenRouter slugs (with a '/') are refreshed by `python code/agents/prices.py --refresh`; Anthropic models (no '/') have no pricing API, so edit them by hand from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and bump 'checked'.
